nodes.label: Semantic Versioning Principle
nodes.rationale: Package version bumps must follow semver (patch/minor/major) so breaking changes are communicated; enforced by the PR template checklist and programmatically by the PR Check workflow.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Convention
nodes.rationale: Structured commit message prefixes (feat/fix/docs/etc.) keep history readable and enable tooling; team rules require pnpm check and pnpm build to pass before committing.

nodes.label: npm Trusted Publisher (OIDC)
nodes.rationale: Publishing uses npm Trusted Publisher (OpenID Connect) with id-token: write permission instead of an NPM_TOKEN secret, so the publish workflow authenticates to npm without stored credentials.

nodes.label: Version-Pinned Installation Mechanism
nodes.rationale: katsu-config installs dependencies pinned to the exact versions used by this package's own package.json (e.g. typescript, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8) so generated projects are reproducible.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Support Principle
nodes.rationale: The CLI must run on Windows, Linux, and macOS; this drives the CommonJS package format for maximum compatibility, npx/pnpm dlx invocation paths, and PowerShell/Command Prompt guidance.

nodes.label: Dynamic Environment Setup Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Selected config files drive dynamic dependency installation (optimized devDependencies) and dynamic npm script generation with duplicate-script avoidance, rather than installing everything upfront.

nodes.label: @katsu996/common-utils Package
nodes.rationale: A personal-use package optimized for the author's individual development style; it bundles utility functions, strict shared config templates, and the katsu-config CLI.

nodes.label: OXC Config Option (oxlint.json)
nodes.rationale: OXC (oxlint/oxfmt) is offered by katsu-config as an alternative linter config id alongside Biome, adding lint/lint:fix/format/format:check scripts.
